summary_en: ¥20,000M buyback authorization. Up to 10,000,000 shares (5.58% of S/O ex-treasury). Execution window Aug 10, 2026–May 15, 2027. Method not disclosed. Rationale: optimize capital structure and address scenarios where future earnings are not fully priced in.
title_en: Notice of Share Buyback Authorization Frame Setting
translation_en_brief: Marui Group's board of directors resolved on August 4, 2026 to set a buyback authorization frame under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied with modification under Article 165(3)). The company will be authorized to acquire up to 10,000,000 shares (5.58% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum outlay of ¥20,000M during the period from August 10, 2026 through May 15, 2027. The stated rationale is to optimize capital structure, improve capital efficiency and shareholder returns, and respond to scenarios where future earnings growth is not yet fully reflected in the stock price. The execution method (open market, ToSTNeT-3, or self-tender) is not specified in the notice. Treasury holdings as of July 31, 2026 comprised 4,606,396 shares (including 133,280 shares held by officer-compensation and equity-grant trusts), and shares outstanding ex-treasury stood at 179,054,021.
